blocks.prompt: 10. Find the equation of the tangent to the parabola \(y^{2} = 12x\) which is parallel to the line \(3x - y + 4 = 0\). Also find the point of tangency.
blocks.explanation:
Pehle samjhein ke 'parallel' ka matlab kya hai: parallel lines ki slope barabar hoti hai. To tangent ki slope wohi hogi jo di gayi line ki hai.
Slope maloom ho to tangent dhoondne ka sab se tez tareeqa 6.3.4 wali shart hai: \(y^{2} = 4ax\) ke liye \(y = mx + c\) tangent tab hai jab \(c = \frac{a}{m}\).
Phir line ko parabola mein rakh kar point of contact (chhone ka point) nikalenge.
Note: di gayi line \(3x - y + 4 = 0\) khud tangent nahi hai (us ka \(c = 4 \ne 1\)); woh parabola ko do jagah se bhi nahi kaatti balke us se milti hi nahi. Hum us ke parallel ek doosri line dhoond rahe hain.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y^{2} = 12x\); tangent line \(3x - y + 4 = 0\) ke parallel hai.
Maloom karna: tangent aur us ka point of contact.
Tareeqa: same slope; shart \(c = \frac{a}{m}\).

\(a\) aur \(m\) parhein
\(4a = 12\), yaani \(a = 3\). Di gayi line \(y = 3x + 4\) hai, slope 3; is liye \(m = 3\).
Kyun: \(y^{2} = 4ax\) se compare kiya, aur line ko \(y = mx + c\) ki shakal mein likha.
Dhyan dein: \(3x - y + 4 = 0\) se \(y = 3x + 4\) aata hai; slope 3, \(-3\) nahi.

Tangency ki shart
\[c = \dfrac{a}{m} = \dfrac{3}{3} = 1\]
Tangent: \(y = 3x + 1\), yaani \(3x - y + 1 = 0\).
Kyun: slope 3 wali saari lines mein se sirf yahi intercept wali line parabola ko chhooti hai; baqi ya to kaatti hain ya milti hi nahi.

Point of tangency
\[(3x + 1)^{2} = 12x\]
\[9x^{2} - 6x + 1 = 0\]
\[(3x - 1)^{2} = 0\]
\[x = \dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[y = 3\left(\dfrac{1}{3}\right) + 1 = 2\]
Kyun: tangent ke liye roots barabar hote hain; wohi dohra root chhone wale point ka \(x\) hai.

Tasdeeq:
\(2^{2} = 4 = 12 \times \frac{1}{3}\): point parabola par hai. Formula \(\left(\frac{a}{m^{2}}, \frac{2a}{m}\right) = \left(\frac{1}{3}, 2\right)\) bhi yahi deta hai. Aur is point par \(yy_{1} = 2a(x + x_{1})\): \(2y = 6\left(x + \frac{1}{3}\right)\), yaani \(y = 3x + 1\). Answer key bhi yahi deti hai.
